data.name: Last Squad Alive
data.detailed_description:
A grounded battle royale shooter set in vast battlegrounds, where every match is a high-stakes winner-take-all shooter experience. Drop into diverse maps, and choose where to land—hot drop into contested areas for instant action or land in outskirts to gear up and prepare.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Jump in solo battle royale or team up in squad battle royale with up to 5 Steam friends. Online matches are filled with players and advanced bots for instant action, and an offline bots-only mode lets you play anytime with no internet required, with full progression preserved.

LAND & LOOT

Drop into battlegrounds and explore diverse maps filled with open areas and dense locations. Loot weapons, loot supplies, discover unique weapons, upgrade with weapon attachments, and find care packages for rare loot. Outfit yourself and gain the edge before your enemies do.

FIGHT & SURVIVE

Fight opponents in intense encounters from long range fights to close combat. Outthink opponents, outrun opponents, and outshoot opponents to stay alive. The safe zone is always moving—zone closing, an ever-shrinking zone where risk increases and you will inevitably encounter other players. Every turn could be your last, die and you’re out.

ONLY ONE WINS

There can only be the last one standing. Fight to survive, win the match, and claim victory for the ultimate victory royale.

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY

Every match is different. No two battles are the same. With changing maps and dynamic gameplay, you must constantly adapt to survive across large, evolving battlegrounds.
